subject: The 3AM email that saved my GPA
preview_text: One student's midnight panic turned into an A- paper. Here's how she did it with your app.
body_paragraphs: It was 3AM, and I was staring at a blinking cursor on a blank document. My paper was due in 8 hours, and I hadn't written a single word. I felt like a fraud, like everyone would find out I didn't belong.

That's when I remembered the Thesis Generator app I'd downloaded weeks ago but never opened. Out of desperation, I typed in my topic and hit 'generate thesis.' Within minutes, I had a strong, defensible claim—something I'd been wrestling with for days. The outline it built me wasn't just structure; it gave me a roadmap. I was no longer lost.

You've got the same tool. Open it, and use the 'Generate Thesis' feature. It's designed to break through that paralysis, turning panic into progress. You don't have to be a genius at 3AM; you just need a starting point. Let the app build that for you.
Open Thesis Generator now and type in your topic. Watch the cursor become an argument. P.S. It works for APA, MLA, and Chicago—so your citations don't add to the stress.
